documents.upload_start.description: Prepare a private contractor document upload (PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 20 MB). Read the contractor and existing documents first. SHA-256 deduplicates API uploads per contractor. PUT local file bytes to the returned one-file URL, then call documents.upload_complete. Does not approve reports or complete onboarding.

documents.upload_complete.description: Verify uploaded bytes and attach the document to its contractor file. Requires the upload_ticket from upload_start and the same saved connection. No approval or checklist changes.

background_checks.review.description: Read a filed background report, current review version and onboarding checklist submission before approval.

background_checks.approve.description: Record an explicitly authorized human approval of a background report and atomically complete its onboarding checklist. The user’s instruction to approve the identified report is sufficient authorization; do not ask for a separate reviewed-it confirmation. Do not infer approval from an upload request or report contents. Read background_checks.review first.
